mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.device_type FROM t_device AS d WHERE d.status = 'ONLINE' ORDER BY d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_device (device_code, device_name, device_type, building_id, floor, altitude, status, location, install_time) VALUES (#{device.deviceCode}, #{device.deviceName}, #{device.deviceType}, #{device.buildingId}, #{device.floor}, #{device.altitude}, #{device.status}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{device.lon}, #{device.lat}), 4326), COALESCE(#{device.installTime}, now()))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_device SET device_code = #{device.deviceCode}, device_name = #{device.deviceName}, device_type = #{device.deviceType}, building_id = #{device.buildingId}, floor = #{device.floor}, altitude = #{device.altitude}, status = #{device.status}, location = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{device.lon}, #{device.lat}), 4326) WHERE id = #{device.id}
